turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: Hi Ana, thanks for joining. I'm a recruiter with Acme Pagamentos, and this will be a quick call of about 20 minutes so we can get to know each other and I can tell you more about the Backend Engineer role. To start, could you give me a short pitch about yourself and your background?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I am a backend developer with five years of experience building payment APIs.

turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: Great, payments APIs are right at the core of what we do here. Could you tell me a bit more about your most recent role at Exemplo Tech, like what you worked on day to day and which technologies you used?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I am looking for 14 to 18,000 rees a month.

turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: Thanks for being upfront about that, it helps. Just to confirm, that's 14 to 18 thousand reais per month, and is that for a CLT contract or as PJ? After that I'd still like to hear a bit more about your work at Exemplo Tech.

turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: Thirty days works well for us, thank you. Going back to your salary range for a moment, is the 14 to 18 thousand reais for a CLT contract or a PJ arrangement? It makes a real difference on our side.
